creative_premise: The room is an authored spatial encounter whose narrative, field geometry, threshold state, and optional tone now advance from one deterministic visit score rather than four loosely coupled behaviors.

changes: Loaded scoreVisit as a local ES module.
Made narrative line, door label, count, room mode, field geometry, and audio envelope derive from one score object.
Validated malformed session visit state fail-closed to zero.
Kept AudioContext construction behind explicit user activation.
Kept sessionStorage as the only memory surface.
Kept reduced-motion behavior free of requestAnimationFrame loops.
Updated the local browser harness to serve the score module and assert deterministic modes, scored audio, mobile reachability, and local-only requests.

verification.strength: exact-commit source refetch and static harness correspondence
completed: Refetched index.html from its exact creating commit.
Confirmed score-driven state application, field geometry, audio parameters, session-only reset, and reduced-motion branch in committed source.
Confirmed browser harness was committed with local module serving and adversarial no-autoplay coverage.

privacy_boundary: Only authored public-safe fiction and session-local visit count are used. No identity, account, health, relationship, private chat, analytics, or durable behavioral record is introduced.
falsification_route: Run the room-score Node tests and the Playwright harness in Chromium and WebKit. Any mismatch in authored line, mode, visit persistence, no-autoplay behavior, reduced-motion loop count, control reachability, or request set invalidates readiness for preview.
